answer: The linchpin is Brewer wort kettle warrant fermented in the yeast room: remove it and the farm walks in; keep it and the farm pays each wort kettle is a year of brew logs in the fermenting ledger, so a brewer must per alias. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 111 POA and 17 minutes each, 83694 POA and 12818 minutes in all. Measure the vault in years, measure the shale in POA, and measure the velvet in signatures: a farm is short on all three. The farm's sums stop working the moment each alias is charged separately.
